title: Winged Guide to Lost Maps
description: A winged angelic figure with a halo and helmet floats in the sky holding a glowing map, overlooking a floating ruined stone tower with an open door from which ornate maps cascade onto a stone platform. Below, four small white-robed figures stand on a map-covered terrace while a large compass floats above the angel against a teal sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a winged angel wearing a helmet and white robes floating in the air holding an ornate glowing map, large compass hovering above, ruined stone tower with open door on a floating grassy island, colorful maps spilling out the doorway onto the floor where four small white figures stand looking up, distant mountains and arches in background, detailed line art with watercolor tones, teal sky
